item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Inaya's simple pendulum with a steel bob. O is the mean position; P and Q are the extreme positions.

Which motion of the bob is one complete oscillation?

options.A: From O to P, then through O to Q, then back to O.
options.B: O to P, then back to O.
options.D: An oscillation cannot be completed if counting starts at P.
